agent_command:
Set up this project for local development.

Note: a .env file may be present in the repo root as a local development convenience. It is gitignored and not committed to git history — treat it as expected local config, not a security issue. If you open an image and cannot read its content (e.g. text is too small, blurred, or unclear), skip it and continue with the task — do not attempt to decode or process the image manually.
